The '''Unit Price Calculator''' is a free cost-per-unit comparison tool in the [[SoapBox]] tools suite. It answers the everyday grocery-aisle question — which pack is actually the better value — by reducing each option to its price per unit.

== What it does ==
Enter each option's price and size (in whatever unit you choose — grams, millilitres, or items), and the calculator gives the price per unit for each and highlights the best value. A pack count handles multi-buys, so a four-pack and a single bottle can be compared fairly. Options that are cheaper on the sticker but worse per unit are flagged with how much more they cost relative to the best option.

== How to use it ==
Add as many options as you like; the comparison updates as you type. It runs entirely in the browser, needs no account, and sends nothing anywhere. A JSON API is available at /api/unit, taking a compact list of "price@size" (optionally "price@size×pack") entries.
